newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm oil prices little changed.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm oil prices little changed.

text.p: Indonesian crude palm oil and olein prices were little changed in late trading on Monday, with some downward tendency, traders said.
They said there was no trade heard in the crude palm oil market because buyers were reluctant to pay at the last tendered price of 1,255 rupiah/kg.
One trader in Medan said sellers viewed the current weakening in offshore markets as a short-term technical correction after recent rises.
"So there is not much downside. If prices offshore start to recover again, our local market will have to follow," the trader said.
Traders said buyers were also cautious because of possible supply from the state commodity regulator Bulog which had bought some olein last month to ease tight domestic supply.
One trader said sellers were not really worried because prices now were hovering around the level Bulog wanted.
Crude palm oil was still offered at 1,255 rupiah/kg in Medan. Ready palm olein was quoted at 1,450 rupiah/kg in Medan, 1,480 rupiah/kg in Jakarta and 1,525 rupiah in Surabaya.
